blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of current V205 renders shows both front thighs projecting beyond the overskirt during crouch and sit; the lilac front hem and panels fold back behind the knees despite widening the thigh-follow band. Outer-skirt coverage remains unusable in both required poses.
Front, three-quarter, neutral and side views still show dense angular crushed creases across the front overskirt; the broader follow band did not address the pleat surface response.
Prone render still tents/bunches the skirt, side silhouettes retain a trailing hem step, and gray gaps remain at sleeve roots/armholes including raised-arm view.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
